intro.text:
The tables below define the display, labelling, and behavioural requirements for the Bank Service Initiation
 consents (Single Instant Payment and Multi Payment) in the LFI Consent Management Interface (CMI). See the User Experience
 page for interactive wireframes of the dashboard and detail pages.

The LFI CMI shares the same structure and consent-type logic as the TPP CMI for Bank Service Initiation
, with the differences noted below. Adjustments to the requirements below are permitted provided the customer can always clearly understand what consents they have granted. Any adjustments must be documented in your CX certification submission.

blocks.text:
Paused
 is not a valid status in the LFI CMI. It is a TPP-local concept that is not reflected in the API Hub.
The dashboard must present Bank Service Initiation consents across two tabs.

rows:
The Current
 tab must display all consents whose status is AwaitingAuthorization
, Authorized
, or Suspended
.

The History
 tab must display all consents whose status is Rejected
, Consumed
, Expired
, or Revoked
.

blocks.text: A filter panel must be available on the dashboard. The following three filters are required:

rows: Dynamically populated from the TPPs present in the customer's connections
Dynamically populated from the types present in the current tab
Dynamically populated from the statuses present in the current tab

blocks.text: Consent statuses must be translated from their API values into user-friendly labels before display.

For Single Instant Payments in the Consumed
 state, the displayed label is derived from the payment's paymentStatus
 field rather than the consent status.

For Multi Payment consents, Consumed
 is displayed verbatim as Consumed
.
Each consent card on the dashboard must show a consistent set of fields depending on the payment consent type.

sections.heading: Dashboard — card content > Single Instant Payment

rows: Name of the TPP the consent was granted to

Masked payer IBAN (not shown when status is AwaitingAuthorization
)
Date the payment was or is to be made

Amount of the payment in AED. Shown as 0.00
 when status is AwaitingAuthorization
; must be a positive value once the consent is Authorized
 or later

sections.heading: Dashboard — card content > Multi Payment (all subtypes)

rows: Name of the TPP the consent was granted to

Masked payer IBAN (not shown when status is AwaitingAuthorization
)
Cumulative sum of all successful payments under this consent in AED

blocks.text:
Selecting a consent on the dashboard opens its detail page. The detail page presents the same information the customer saw at the time they gave consent — the limits, accounts, and conditions that defined what they agreed to. In addition to all fields shown on the dashboard card, the detail page must show a truncated Consent ID with a copy button (format: f47ac10b...d479
).

sections.heading: Detail page > Single Instant Payment — additional sections

rows:
Amount, Reference, and Payment Purpose. If status is Authorized
, a Status badge of Authorized
 must also be shown.
Bank name, Payer Name, and full IBAN of the payer account
Payee Name and IBAN of the destination account

sections.heading: Detail page > Multi Payment — additional sections

rows: Bank name, Payer Name, and full IBAN of the payer account
Payee Name and IBAN of the destination account
Tabbed section: Payment Rules shows consent parameters (schedule, limits, frequency); Payment History shows a log of all payments with date, amount, purpose, reference, and status

blocks.text:
No action buttons are shown when status is Consumed
, Expired
, Rejected
, or Revoked
.

When the customer selects Revoke, replace the detail view with a single confirmation screen
 that includes: a title, a description of the impact of the action on the service, a Confirm button, and a Go back button.

Once a customer confirms the action, the change must take effect immediately — there must be no delay between confirmation and the consent reflecting its new state. The LFI must update the consent status via the Consent Manager API.
